name: Multi-Tenant SaaS
description: Simulates a multi-tenant SaaS platform where each tenant has isolated data but shares the same tables. Tests row-level isolation, cross-tenant queries, tenant provisioning, and the library's multi-region support for REGIONAL BY ROW patterns.

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenants (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name STRING NOT NULL, plan STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free', region STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'us-east', max_users INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_tenants_plan (plan), INDEX idx_tenants_region (region))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_users (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), email STRING NOT NULL, role STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member', last_login TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_email (email), INDEX idx_users_tenant (tenant_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_data (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), data_key STRING NOT NULL, data_value JSONB NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_data_tenant_key (tenant_id, data_key))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_events (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), event_type STRING NOT NULL, payload JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_events_tenant_time (tenant_id, created_at DESC))
seed_sql: INSERT INTO tenants (id, name, plan, region) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'Tenant ' || generate_series::STRING, CASE (generate_series % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'free' WHEN 1 THEN 'pro' ELSE 'enterprise' END, CASE (generate_series % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'us-east' WHEN 1 THEN 'us-west' ELSE 'eu-west' END FROM generate_series(1, 100)

INSERT INTO tenant_users (tenant_id, email, role) SELECT t.id, 'user' || generate_series::STRING || '@tenant' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.id)::STRING || '.com', CASE (generate_series % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'admin' WHEN 1 THEN 'member' ELSE 'viewer' END FROM tenants t, generate_series(1, 3)

operations.name: tenant_data_read
sql: SELECT d.data_key, d.data_value, d.version, d.updated_at FROM tenant_data d WHERE d.tenant_id = $1 ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC LIMIT 20

operations.name: tenant_data_write
sql: INSERT INTO tenant_data (tenant_id, data_key, data_value) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, data_key) DO UPDATE SET data_value = $3, version = tenant_data.version + 1, updated_at = now()
INSERT INTO tenant_events (tenant_id, event_type, payload) VALUES ($1, 'data_updated', $4)

operations.name: user_login
sql: UPDATE tenant_users SET last_login = now() WHERE email = $1
INSERT INTO tenant_events (tenant_id, event_type, payload) VALUES ($2, 'user_login', $3)

operations.name: cross_tenant_analytics
sql: SELECT t.plan, t.region, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) as tenant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as data_items FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN tenant_users u ON u.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tenant_data d ON d.tenant_id = t.id GROUP BY t.plan, t.region ORDER BY tenant_count DESC

operations.name: tenant_event_stream
sql: SELECT e.event_type, e.payload, e.created_at, t.name as tenant_name FROM tenant_events e JOIN tenants t ON t.id = e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id = $1 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

operations.name: provision_tenant
sql: INSERT INTO tenants (name, plan, region) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
INSERT INTO tenant_users (tenant_id, email, role) VALUES (currval('tenants_id_seq'), $4, 'admin')
INSERT INTO tenant_events (tenant_id, event_type, payload) VALUES (currval('tenants_id_seq'), 'tenant_created', $5)

operations.name: follower_read_dashboard
sql: SELECT t.name, t.plan, t.region, COUNT(u.id) as users, COUNT(d.id) as data_items FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN tenant_users u ON u.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tenant_data d ON d.tenant_id = t.id WHERE t.region = $1 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.plan, t.region ORDER BY users DESC LIMIT 25
